body: Accuracy knob for TTK rejected: police aim_error 9 deg gives median 12.9 s but seeds spread 5.4-30 s and the hold-fire wedge (aim error + spread, 60 m overshoot) widens to +-7 m at 30 m, starving cops in crowds; gang 1 shotgun trio stays at 4.5 s median even at 12 deg (single blasts with head pellets kill in one tick).

TTK knob = damage: DamageScale component (combat) read by fire_weapons, written from escalation.ron stars[].damage_scale (0.15/0.15/0.2/0.25/0.3) by police_fsm and gangs.ron combat.damage_scale (0.2) by gang_fsm; alternative accuracy spread rejected (see dead_end).

Traffic hit: per_mps 12 -> 6.5 plus shove_scale 0.6 -> 1.0; per_mps alone rejected because the traffic car re-hits the knocked-down body (15.39, 8.48, 5.18 m/s contacts sum past 100 even at per_mps 5); shove >= 0.8 throws the body clear, one hit of 81.

1-star 'shoots at police' = a player BulletTrace passing within arrest.near_miss_distance (1.5 m, 3D) of a live cop's body centre, or any player DamageDealt on a cop; witnessed attacks on others no longer set PoliceAlert. Alternative (player aim direction at a cop) rejected: aim without a shot is not an attack.

Recommend DamageScale and pedestrian run-over lethality scoped to the player as victim; alternative (shooter/global scope, as shipped) rejected: it cuts police car-stall by ~6.7x (40->267 pistol hits) and raises the NPC run-over kill speed 11.3->18.4 m/s with no gate.

Victim scope: fire_weapons multiplies by the shooter's DamageScale only when the resolved body (ColliderOf.body, so headshots included) has Player; BulletHitVehicle carries unscaled damage plus player_scale, which apply_bullet_hits uses only for a Player driver's cabin wound. Alternative (scale on the shooter, as shipped) rejected per OPEN_DECISIONS: it cut police car-stall 6.7x.

pedestrian.per_mps back to 12 for NPCs, player_share 0.4 for the player: standing at cruise 15.39 m/s -> 59 (health 41), running head-on 18.75 m/s -> 76 (health 24), kills from ~23.8 m/s. Alternative share 0.5 rejected: running into a 16 m/s car at 4.5 m/s gives (20.5-3)*6 = 105, a kill.

Flipping the TTK ceiling with damage_scale 0.01 alone stays green (2-star 23.95 s, 5-star 10.00 s): roll_damage floors every hit at 1 hp. The flip needs a slower trigger too (trigger_seconds 2-3 s -> 40.00 / 37.19 s, RED).

Runtime 1-star TTK measured by holding PoliceAlert.hostile_left via BRP mutation (mirrors the headless named mutation) instead of re-shooting cops each window; alternative (keep attacking the cops) rejected: a hit escalates heat (wound_cop 80, kill_cop 150) and changes the row under test.
